text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000146 bills 99215 well above risk-adjusted expectation in every complexity band, but the few documented 99215 charts all support the billed level, so the evidence is mixed.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The excess is not confined to sicker patients. The 99215 share runs roughly three to four times the all-provider share even among patients with one or two conditions (for example C0075192, C0075223 and C0075574), which a sicker panel would not explain on its own. On the other side, none of the 7 documented 99215 claims fell below the billed level, and no moderate-plus data claims lacked a lab line. That points toward supported coding, but 7 charts out of 109 99215 claims is too thin to settle the question. One detail deserves attention: C0075108, a single-condition hypothyroidism visit documented as high MDM, is also one of the notes flagged on the problems check, and the time-repeat signal is non-trivial with no audit trail received. That fits a pattern in which notes could be inflated to match the billed level, though it is not proof. A reviewer should first request more charts for the 1- and 2-condition 99215 claims listed here, together with the EHR audit trail, and confirm whether the high-MDM problem documentation reflects what actually happened at those visits."}
